sentences.en: We just had a fire drill, so everyone knows what to do now.
sentences.zh: 刚刚进行了消防演习，所以现在每个人都知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: The school conducts fire drills twice a year to ensure safety.
sentences.zh: 学校每年进行两次消防演习以确保安全。

sentences.en: During the fire drill, everyone must leave the building quickly and calmly.
sentences.zh: 在消防演习期间，每个人必须迅速而冷静地离开建筑物。
